cases.description: #N/A from a failed MATCH is caught
IFNA only catches #N/A; #DIV/0! must pass through unchanged
cases.expected_note: Common compat pitfall: IFNA is NOT a general error trap like IFERROR

cases.description: No error: original value passes through
IFNA only traps #N/A, so the #REF! from an INDIRECT naming a missing sheet must pass straight through
cases.expected_note: Documented scope difference, not a quirk: IFNA returns value_if_na for #N/A only, while IFERROR traps every error value. Excel function reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/excel-functions-alphabetical-b3944572-255d-4efb-bb96-c6d90033e188
